name: 92694 · Ladera Ranch, CA
findings: ZIP 92694 (Ladera Ranch) has 73 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92694 (Ladera Ranch) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
29% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 92694 (Ladera Ranch) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 31 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
